findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT logs list risky hostname staging.copperline.example with pattern 'staging', first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15; risky_hostnames_count 1, unique_hostnames 12.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly logged staging system may expose non-production data or weaker controls and expand attack surface; validate its access controls and need before close, with limited expected deal impact if isolated or decommissioned.

remediation.summary: Confirm staging host is required, restrict to VPN/allowlist or decommission, and ensure no production data or credentials are present.
